name: Family Tree – Organization Chart
author: wpmart

sections.description:
Family Tree – Organization Chart lets you show a family tree, a company org chart, a team structure or any other hierarchy on your site. Add your members once, build as many charts as you need, style them live and place them with a shortcode.

Features

  • Members with name, designation, short details, full profile (WordPress editor), picture and social icons.
  • Visual tree builder on each chart. Add, move, nest or remove members, or create a new member without leaving the page.
  • Templates. Pick a template and get a ready shortcode: [ftree_6310_tree id="123"].
  • Live customizer for fonts, colors, spacing, alignment, image size, connector lines and buttons, with an instant preview.
  • Profile popup that shows the member’s full profile.
  • Expand and collapse branches.
  • Zoom in, zoom out and full screen buttons, which you can turn on or off per chart.
  • Mobile responsive. On small screens the chart becomes an easy-to-read indented list.
  • Demo data. Import 7 sample members and a chart on activation to get started quickly.
  • Theme overrides. Copy any file from templates/ into your-theme/family-tree/ to change the markup.
  • Translation ready and compatible with WPML, Polylang and other multilingual plugins (see below). RTL languages are supported.

Multilingual (WPML, Polylang)

  • Members are translatable posts. Translate a member in WPML or Polylang as you would a page.
  • You build a chart once. It shows each member’s translation in the visitor’s language and falls back to the original when a translation is missing.
  • The chart title and button text are translatable strings. Use WPML → String Translation or Polylang → Languages → Translations, group “Family Tree – Organization Chart”.
  • A wpml-config.xml file is included, so WPML knows which member fields to translate and which to copy.

Pro

A Pro license unlocks templates 02 to 06, contact rows, skills with percentage bars and unlimited social icons per member. The free version includes template 01, one social icon per member, zoom and full screen.

External services

This plugin connects to the wpmart license server only to activate a Pro license. Nothing is sent unless you enter a license key on the Family Tree → License page.

  • Service: wpmart license server, https://demo.tcsesoft.com/activation-ftree.php
  • When: when you activate, deactivate or refresh a license, and once a day while a license is active.
  • Data sent: the license key, the site URL, the plugin slug and the plugin version.
  • Provider: wpmart. Terms of use and privacy policy: https://www.wpmart.org/

Credits

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New, or upload the wm-family-tree-organization-chart folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin. You can import the demo data from the notice that appears.
  3. Add members under Family Tree → Add Member.
  4. Go to Family Tree → Templates & Shortcodes, pick a template, then build the tree on the Members tab and style it on the Design tab.
  5. Copy the shortcode into any page, post or widget.
sections.faq:
How do I show a chart on a page?

Copy the shortcode from Family Tree → Templates & Shortcodes (for example [ftree_6310_tree id="123"]) and paste it into a page or a Shortcode block.

Can one member appear in several charts?

Yes. Members are shared, and each chart keeps its own tree.

How do I translate a chart?

Translate the members with WPML or Polylang. The chart then shows the translated members automatically. Translate the chart title and button text under String Translation (WPML) or Languages → Translations (Polylang).

Can I change the HTML of the cards?

Yes. Copy a file from the plugin’s templates/ folder to your-theme/family-tree/ and edit it there.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Charts and plugin settings are removed. Members are kept, so you don’t lose your content.
